message.content:
A tall vertical editorial illustration features a white pickup truck heavily loaded with household goods, driven by a man with gray hair and a black cap. The truck is positioned on the bottom right, facing right. Its bed and roof are piled high with oversized items, including several large, gray, rounded bundles tied with rope, a tall gray metal cabinet, a white box fan, a framed portrait of a man and a woman, a potted Monstera plant, a white table lamp, a wooden chair, a blue water jug, and a white washing machine. These items are stacked precariously, reaching nearly to the top of the frame. 

The background is a solid light green, with a thick red vertical stripe on the far left. Large white text in the center reads "ABAH MASUK ISTANA." Below this, smaller white text says: "MA'RUF AMIN MENYIAPKAN DIRI MENJELANG BERTUGAS SEBAGAI WAKIL PRESIDEN, BENARKAH ANAK-MENANTU MULAI DIDEKATI PENGUSAHA?" Other text at the top includes "MUHAIMIN TERSERET NYANYIAN PEMBOCOR" and "OPERASIPENYELAMATAN TUBAN PETRO." A barcode and publication details appear in the bottom left corner.
